articles.title: USA planerar jättebeställning av nya stridsflyg
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: USA planerar jättebeställning av nya stridsflyg
articles.body_text: Lockheed Martin-stridsflyget F-35 Lightning II/Joint Strike Fighter. Arkivbild USA planerar jättebeställning av nya stridsflyg Amerikanska Lockheed Martin stiger i förhandeln på Wall Street. En stark kvartalsrapport med höjd prognos och en uppgörelse som kan sluta med att Pentagon köper 850 nya F-35-stridsflyg ligger bakom kurslyftet. Pentagon planerar att köpa minst 850 stridsflygplan av modellen F-35 av Lockheed Martin, enligt ett preliminärt kontrakt. Det diskuteras även reservdelar till och uppgraderingar av F-35-flygplanen under tio års tid, enligt USA:s försvarsdepartement. F-35-stridsflygen kostar ungefär 100 miljoner dollar styck. Beskedet kommer samtidigt som Lockheed Martin – som även tillverkar Patriot-robotar – lyfter sin vinstprognos för i år till 30,35–30,75 dollar per aktie. Tidigare låg den på 29,95–30,65 dollar per aktie. Lockheeds försäljning i årets tredje kvartal ökade 11 procent i årstakt till 20,7 miljarder dollar och orderboken växte till 292 miljarder dollar. Vinsten lyfte 7 procent i kvartalet till 2,4 miljarder dollar.

articles.title: Bankernas bolåneklirr bromsar in
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Bankernas bolåneklirr bromsar in
articles.body_text: Skandia justerar sina bolåneräntor. Arkivbild. Storbankerna har lagt korten på bordet för årets tredje kvartal. Räntenettot – det bankerna tjänar på bland annat bolån – blev en besvikelse för direktörerna. Bankernas vinster har generellt kommit ner under en period, men de är fortsatt på höga nivåer, säger Moa Langemark, konsumentskyddsekonom på Finansinspektionen. Räntenettot är det bankerna tjänar på skillnaden mellan in- och utlåningsräntor (till stor del handlar det om räntor på bolån). Totalt uppgick storbankernas räntenetto till drygt 52 miljarder kronor under kvartalet, vilket var något lägre än bedömarnas förväntningar. Handelsbankens siffra var dessutom lägre jämfört med samma kvartal i fjol. Räntenettot har gått ner lite grann. Det kan bero på att kunder är mer aktiva i sina bolåneaffärer, säger Langemark. Men kunderna bör vara ännu mer aktiva, menar hon. Bolån är ju en helt utbytbar vara. Det är ju inte så att du får ett snyggare bolån eller ett trevligare bolån genom att flytta det – det är precis samma produkt, säger hon, och tillägger att det gör det enklare för kunder att byta bank. Som bolånekund bör man jämföra sin banks villkor med konkurrenterna, säger hon. Jag tycker att man som kund bör vara otrogen mot sin bank och pressa den, enklast gör man det genom att vara påläst och ta reda på vad andra banker erbjuder. Enligt bankerna handlar det oväntat låga räntenettot om tuff konkurrens. Vi ser att köpare och säljare hittar varandra och det är en marknad som växer. Men det är också en marknad som kännetecknas av väldigt hög konkurrens, säger Swedbanks vd Jens Henriksson.

articles.title: Tyska försvarskällor: Välj Jas Gripen
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Tyska försvarskällor: Välj Jas Gripen
articles.body_text: Jas 39 Gripen skickas till Italien för en Natoövning. Arkivbild. Välj Saabs Jas-plan före det brittiska alternativet. Det förordar tjänstemän på tyska försvarsdepartementet när landet ska satsa på nya stridsflygplan, enligt Politico. I somras kraschade de långt gångna planerna mellan Frankrike och Tyskland på att ta fram ett gemensamt stridsflygplan. Nya planer är nu under arbete, där ett samarbete med det brittiskt ledda projektet Global Combat Air Programme, är ett alternativ. Men enligt en skrivelse av tjänstemän på det tyska försvardsdepartementet som Politico har läst, förordas i stället ett samarbete mellan svenska Saab och flygjätten Airbus och där även Spanien ingår. Saabs stridsflyg Jas Gripen ska användas i partnerskapet i väntan på att nytt stridsflyg tas fram. Skrivelsen är inget slutgiltigt dokument. Tyska försvarsdepartementet vill inte kommentera uppgiften.

articles.title: Fler använder Spotify – ”tar marknadsandelar”
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Fler använder Spotify – ”tar marknadsandelar”
articles.body_text: Kvartalssiffror från streamingtjänsten Spotify. Arkivbild Fler använder Spotify – ”tar marknadsandelar” Spotify växer och ser fortsatt tillväxt framför sig, enligt utsikterna i en kvartalsrapport från strömningstjänsten. Vinsten i tredje kvartalet blev lite högre än väntat, medan intäkterna hamnade precis under förväntan. I terminshandeln på Wall Street är det svagt nedåt för aktien efter siffrorna. Spotifys aktie, ned nästan 10 procent hittills i år, sjunker ytterligare drygt 2 procent i terminshandeln efter rapporten. Kvartalsrapporten visar att antalet månatliga användare av den Stockholmsbaserade musik- och podcast-bjässen ökade med 11 procent i årstakt till 788 miljoner under tredje kvartalet. Antalet betalande så kallade premiumabonnenter ökade med 9 procent till 306 miljoner. Spotifys egen prognos låg på 788 miljoner månatliga användare under tredje kvartalet, varav 305 miljoner premiumanvändare. Rörelseresultatet lyfte med 15 procent i årstakt till 672 miljoner euro, vilket var mer än väntat. De totala intäkterna steg 16 procent till 4,97 miljarder euro – marginellt under snittprognosen på 4,98 miljarder euro, enligt Bloomberg. ”Vi investerar där vi ser en väg till tillväxt, kostnadsökningarna avtar och vi har fortfarande mycket kvar att hämta. Vi har inte bara ett branschledande användarengagemang, vi har också världens mest passionerade och engagerade fans av musik, poddar och böcker på vår plattform. Det är därför vi fortsätter att öka och ta marknadsandelar”, säger Alex Norström, en av Spotifys två vd:ar, i en kommentar. Den andra vd:n Gustav Söderström tonar samtidigt ned AI-hotet mot Spotify som strömningstjänst. ”AI-agenter är särskilt bra på att ersätta och ta hand om sådant som människor helst slipper göra. De flesta lämnar gärna ifrån sig vardagssysslor, men underhållning fungerar precis tvärtom. Ingen ber en AI-agent att ”sammanfatta en låt” åt dem. Hela poängen med att låta någon annan sköta de sysslorna är att få ännu mer tid över till det vi faktiskt tycker om att göra”, säger han i en kommentar. Spotifys tillväxt syns i alla regioner och bolaget tillägger att man ser fortsatt tillväxt framåt.

articles.title: Halvledarlyft för Atlas Copco – men aktien faller
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Halvledarlyft för Atlas Copco – men aktien faller
articles.body_text: Halvledarlyft för Atlas Copco – men aktien faller Verkstadskoncernen Atlas Copco har medvind just nu. Orderingång lyfte till 52,3 miljarder kronor under tredje kvartalet, en ökning med 29 procent jämfört med motsvarande kvartal i fjol. Ökningen var större än väntat, inte minst på grund av ökad efterfrågan på utrustning till halvledarindustrin. Analytiker hade i genomsnitt räknat med en orderingång på 50,2 miljarder, enligt Bloomberg. Men marknaden reagerar negativt och aktien faller 7 procent efter rapporten. Rörelseresultatet lyfter också kraftigt, upp 16 procent till 9 950 miljoner kronor. Där låg dock förväntningarna bland analytiker högre, med en snittprognos på cirka 10 330 miljoner.

articles.title: Publicistiska grunden för journalistik på TV4
articles.summary: Nyheter från TV4: Hur fungerar den publicistiska grunden för nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik på TV4?
articles.body_text: Hur fungerar den publicistiska grunden för nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik på TV4? 9 januari 2024 ・ Uppdaterad: 15 augusti 2025 TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsbevakning ska vara i ögonhöjd med tittarna. Vi vill vara nära, personliga och inkluderande. För alla i hela Sverige. Vi ska vara trovärdiga och relevanta. Vi testar nya visuella former och utvecklar det rörliga berättandet. Vi är både snabba, och fördjupande. Vi ger plats för både humor och allvar. Vi påverkar och berör. Vi avslöjar maktmissbruk, och värnar pressfrihet och yttrandefrihet. Vi producerar Nyhetsmorgon, Nyhetsdagen, Efter fem och kvällsnyheter. Vi nyhetsrapporterar på tv4.se och fördjupar i kortdokumentärerna Nyheterna Story. Vår mångfaldigt prisbelönta redaktion Kalla Fakta granskar makt och missförhållanden. TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsbevakning sker ur ett riksperspektiv, med hela Sverige och världen som bevakningsområde. Vi har 17 rikskorrar på sex orter i Sverige. De finns i Luleå, Umeå, Östersund, Skövde, Göteborg och Malmö. Vi bevakar världen via utrikesreportrar, korrar och stringers. Vår journalistik vilar på respekt för alla människors lika värde, oavsett politisk åskådning, religion eller sexuell läggning. Det innebär att vi låter många röster komma till tals, även de som bär åsikter som inte nödvändigtvis delas av medarbetarna på redaktionen eller TV4. Men det kan också innebära att vi tar bort artikelkommentarer som kränker, eller till exempel avstår gäster i direktsändning där vi bedömer att risken är stor för missbruk av öppenheten. TV4:s nyhets- och samhällsjournalistik är oberoende och obunden. Den står fri från politiska partier, organisationer, och näringsliv. Vi har ingen ledarsida eller politisk färg. Innehållet på våra plattformar bedöms och värderas av redaktörer, producenter och av ansvarig utgivare före publicering. Vi följer grundlagen och skyddar våra källor när de önskar anonymitet. Om vi refererar uppgifter från andra medier redovisar vi vilka medier eller andra informationskällor det handlar om. Annars berättar vi hur vi själva tagit reda på informationen, dock alltid med största respekt för källskydd.

articles.title: Kulturnyheterna special: Avgörs valet på TikTok?
articles.summary: För första gången finns alla partiledare på Tiktok, samtidigt som nästan hälften av alla förstagångsväljare säger att de oftare tar del av politik på sociala medier än i tidningar, radio och tv. Vad gör det här med politiken, och är det på en kinesisk plattform som framställs som en säkerhetsrisk som det svenska valet kommer att avgöras? Medverkande: Emanuel Karlsten, journalist, Kajsa Falasca, forskare, och Oscar Samuelsson, kommunikationsrådgivare. Programledare: Cecilia Tiberg.

articles.title: Bortglömda fiskar
articles.summary: Teatrar och konserthus lockar allt oftare med olika sidoevenemang. Teater Västernorrland har musikquiz, Folkoperan sänder poddar från sin foajé och på Göteborgsoperan kan man höra föredrag eller vara med och dansa. De uppsluppna tillställningarna, före och efter konserter och föreställningar, lockar också en ny sorts publik. En av Östersjöfestivalens mest omtalade programpunkter, förutom musiken i Berwaldhallen, har varit “Bortglömda fiskar” - en oväntad kulinarisk träff med Kålrotsakademin och provsmakning av “svensk sushi”. “Gensvaret från publiken är enormt. Man vill bli överraskad”, konstaterar Emma Nyberg, exekutiv producent på Berwaldhallen. Och på frågan om vad nors och näbbgädda har att göra i ett konserthus kommer det självklara svaret snabbt: “Att äta gott och att lyssna på klassisk musik hör ihop, båda skärper och öppnar våra sinnen.”

articles.title: Storm Adam flooding: At least four dead in southern France
articles.summary: The deaths include two women found drowned in a cellar in the Bouches-du-Rhône region.
articles.body_text: At least four people have died in France, and one other has been injured, after flooding caused by Storm Adam. The storm triggered widespread flooding across southern France on Tuesday, inundating streets and disrupting transport. The deaths included two women aged 86 and 26 who were found drowned in a cellar in the Bouches-du-Rhône region. Corsica was also hit by severe weather. Local media reported that a 4x4 vehicle was swept away by floodwaters on Tuesday - one of the occupants escaped through a window, but another man was found dead . Authorities have not released further details about the fourth death. In the towns of Mouriès and Saint-Martin-de-Crau, between Montpellier and Marseille, dozens of residents were accommodated in emergency shelters after the floods hit. Officials said one person had been injured in that area. Roads and train lines ‌in ⁠the area were also disrupted, Transport Minister Philippe Tabarot wrote in a post ​on X. "The water has risen to unprecedented levels," Jacques Witkowski, prefect of the Bouches-du-Rhône department, said in a statement on Wednesday. Witkowski expressed "a thought for all those who are in distress", adding: "We are mobilised at an exceptional level to resolve several issues." More severe weather is forecast in France, with Storm Austen - a newly named weather system moving in from the Atlantic - expected to reach the country's north-west. France's weather service, Météo-France, has issued an orange-level wind warning for five western departments from Thursday evening into Friday. The alert covers Côtes-d'Armor, Finistère, Morbihan, Ille-et-Vilaine and Manche. Storm Adam had already brought severe flooding to eastern Spain, where at least three people were killed.

articles.title: Moment man rescued from sinking car by Australian TV reporter
articles.summary: Journalist Will Murray describes how he and a bystander saved an SUV driver from his vehicle.
articles.body_text: A man in a sinking car has been saved by a TV journalist after driving into deep flood water. Will Murray was at the scene reporting for the Australian Broadcasting Corporation in Morayfield, Queensland, when he saw a vehicle drive past him into the water. Murray, and a bystander, rushed to help the driver as the SUV sank. Murray says when it became clear the car was sinking very fast "there was no thinking involved", because the man might have drowned. "Better that you jump in and give it a crack", Murray tells BBC News. The BBC spoke to people in Sydney about Australia's plans to force social media companies to allow users to easily opt in or out of personalised algorithms. A SpaceX rocket that blasted off from Texas in July, and crashed into the Indian Ocean, made an unexpected appearance off Christmas Island. Lawyers for Erin Patterson say her conviction was undermined by a "catastrophic" mix-up that led to the jury staying at the same hotel as prosecutors and a key witness. The BBC’s Katy Watson explains why triple-murderer Erin Patterson is back in court this week trying to overturn her conviction. The humpback whale later successfully freed itself after the tide rose in Queensland, Australia. A police pursuit in Queensland has ended in two arrests, with authorities taken on a high-speed car chase across Ipswich and Brisbane. Seven-year-old Miles Phillips' hit song has now had 1.5m views and was even played on the radio.

articles.title: First human case of Shamonda virus detected in France, officials say
articles.summary: The disease, which usually affects cattle, has been identified in a patient who died in early October.
articles.body_text: The first known human case of the Shamonda virus (Shav) has been detected in a patient who died in early October, French authorities have said. Health officials said it was an "exceptional case in a severely immunocompromised patient" and there was currently no risk to the public. Shav is a disease that primarily affects cattle and can be spread by infected midges. Cases have also occurred in sheep, goats, alpacas and horses, but infections in people were previously unheard of. The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) said it was monitoring the situation and officials were still investigating how the virus had spread to a human. It is currently thought the patient contracted Shav through a midge bite in eastern France, the country's health and agriculture ministries said on Thursday, where cases were first identified in animals in the spring. They said the patient was being treated for a serious illness in a Lyon hospital and experienced neurological complications thought to have been "very likely linked" to the virus, based on initial findings. The statement stressed that their immune system was weakened, leaving them more vulnerable to getting ill. "Until now, the Shamonda virus was considered non-transmissible to humans," it noted, having only been identified in animals "despite decades of circulation of the Shamonda virus in Africa and Asia". Dairy herds that catch Shav from bites can experience fever, diarrhoea and poor milk production. The ECDC said it was working with French and European partners to investigate the "potential public health implications" of the infection. The first cases of the virus in Europe were identified in late July, the agency said. It has since been detected in farm animals in several countries, including Ireland, Germany, Italy and Spain, as well as in Jersey. The case has also been reported to the World Health Organization.

articles.title: El Salvador's president threatens Haitian gangs over military hostages
articles.summary: Four members of the so-called Gang Suppression Force have been missing since Sunday.
articles.body_text: El Salvador's president has said he has launched a military operation to rescue four air force personnel who have been missing in Haiti since Sunday. Threatening further action, Nayib Bukele said that Wednesday's attack was "nothing" compared with what would happen if all the hostages - who he said were not combatants - were not returned alive. They went missing after being ambushed by "heavily armed criminal groups," El Salvador's armed forces said. The ambush occurred in Croix-des-Bouquets, an area controlled by armed groups. They were part of the so-called Gang Suppression Force (GSF), approved by the United Nations Security Council earlier this month, to tackle escalating gang violence in Haiti. According to an X post from Bukele, the mission consisted of pilots and technical personnel, whose primary jobs were to "carry out medical evacuations and save lives, not to wage war". His post said the Salvadoran military operation's single objective was to bring the four men back home alive. He added that if all four were returned alive, without being harmed, "everything will go back to how it was before the kidnapping". Bukele added they were kidnapped "in a cowardly manner" while returning after buying food at a market in the area. A statement released by the Armed Forces of El Salvador on Sunday said the group was ambushed while travelling back to its camp in an armoured vehicle, which caught fire after being hit by explosives. So far, no gang has claimed responsibility for the attack. Salvadoran helicopters were deployed to assist, with multiple attempts to make an approach by land and air hampered by fighting and local security conditions, the armed forces said. On Wednesday, before Bukele announced the launch of the military operation, the GSF said it was searching for the four missing personnel following the attack.

articles.title: Married at First Sight Australia: Police investigate show after 'inappropriate' allegations
articles.summary: New South Wales Police say inquiries took place "following a report of inappropriate content being shared".
articles.body_text: Married at First Sight Australia is facing fresh controversy after police launched an investigation into the hit reality TV show. New South Wales told BBC News that inquiries had taken place "following a report of inappropriate content being shared". Channel Nine, which broadcasts Married at First Sight Australia, confirmed that it was "aware of a police investigation" involving the show's production company. It is the latest blow for the show, after a BBC News investigation earlier this year into MAFS Australia revealed cast members said they had not been told their partners had previous drug and violence convictions. Those revelations led to a warning from Australia's media watchdog, which called them "serious and disturbing". The British version of Married at First Sight, known to many as MAFS UK, was separately plunged into crisis in May after BBC Panorama reported rape allegations from two female cast members - allegations the men involved have denied. MAFS UK is made by a different production company to the Australian version. Married at First Sight shows single people agreeing to "marry" total strangers after meeting for the first time at their mock weddings. The marriages are not legally binding, but viewers see the couples go on "honeymoons", before moving in together and navigating their relationships - all while being filmed, almost every day. According to industry news website TV Blackbox , a male cast member on the current series of MAFS Australia made a formal complaint to the police after producers allegedly shared private information about him with his on-screen bride. A spokesperson for New South Wales Police Force told BBC News: "On Monday 24 August 2026, officers attached to South Sydney Police Area Command commenced an investigation following a report of inappropriate content being shared. "Following inquiries, the matter will be referred to WA [Western Australia] Police Force."

articles.title: How do Israel's elections work and who are the main contenders?
articles.summary: Many view it as one of the most pivotal elections in Israel's history, with global implications.
articles.body_text: Israel's general election takes place on Tuesday 27 October. It's the first election since the 7 October 2023 Hamas-led attacks on Israel and its subsequent conflicts in Gaza and with Iran, Hezbollah and the Houthis. Many view it as one of the most pivotal elections in Israel's history, with global implications. Current polling puts incumbent Benjamin Netanyahu in a tight race with Gadi Eisenkot, a former head of the Israel Defense Forces, to become prime minister. Eisenkot's popularity stems partly from his military credentials and his relative newness in politics, having formed his Yashar Party only last year. He lost his son, a soldier, in the first months of the Gaza war, and served in Israel's war cabinet under Netanyahu until resigning in 2024 over disagreements about the conflict. He has built his campaign on calls for accountability over the security failures that led to 7 October. Other opposition leaders include former prime minister Naftali Bennett and Avigdor Lieberman - both right-wingers who take hardline positions on security and advocate permanent Israeli control over much of the occupied West Bank - and Yair Golan, a left-winger who supports Israel's withdrawal from large parts of the territory. Despite their differences, they could work with Eisenkot to form a government. Netanyahu's current government is the most right-wing in Israel's history. In order to remain in power, he will likely have to rely on the support of some of his existing far-right coalition partners. Some hold ultra-nationalist positions, such as calling for Israel to annex the West Bank and for the "migration" of Palestinians from Gaza - which could amount to the forced displacement of civilians. Some members of Netanyahu's own Likud party have also called for Palestinian "migration" from the territory. There are two Arab party blocs in the running too, as about one-fifth of Israel's population is Arab - many of whom describe themselves as Palestinian citizens of Israel. In theory, they could prove kingmakers. But all but one of the leading Jewish parties have ruled out working with them. Israel's parliament - known as the Knesset - has 120 seats, meaning a government must hold 61 seats to command a majority. Israel uses a proportional representation voting system, meaning governments have always been coalitions of multiple parties. This means that after election day, it may take weeks or even months before the next government is formed - with different parties wrangling for concessions and deals being struck.

articles.title: Two killed in attack on airport in eastern Saudi Arabia, authorities say
articles.summary: It is the latest in a series of attacks by the Houthi movement which have targeted airports and other sites in the kingdom.
articles.body_text: Two people were killed and eight others injured in an attack on an airport in Dammam, eastern Saudi Arabia on Wednesday evening, the kingdom's General Authority of Civil Aviation (GACA) says. Those killed at King Fahd International Airport were a Saudi citizen and an Indian resident, while the injured were Saudi, Indian, Yemeni, Bangladeshi and Nepalese nationals. The GACA did not say what type of attack occurred, but Yemen's Iran-backed Houthi movement has repeatedly targeted the kingdom's airports with drones and missiles. On Wednesday morning, two people were killed by debris from a drone that was intercepted over Eastern Province, where Dammam is located, the Saudi energy ministry said. The ministry said the drone was intercepted as it attempted to target a processing facility owned by Saudi Arabia's state oil company Aramco in the Shaybeh oil field, where a contractor's vehicle was set ablaze. It identified the dead as residents from the Philippines and Nepal. Another four drones were also intercepted on Wednesday night, according to the Saudi-led coalition that is supporting the Yemeni government in its war against the Houthis. There was no immediate comment from the Houthis, but they have previously said they are attacking Saudi airports, energy facilities and military bases in retaliation for deadly Saudi air strikes on the territory they control in western Yemen. At least 21 people have been killed in Houthi attacks on Saudi airports since the start of October, according to Saudi authorities. One missile strike on Riyadh's international airport on 10 October killed 13 people and injured 308 others – the deadliest attack in Saudi Arabia in more than a decade. The Houthis' military spokesman said on Wednesday that they had targeted military equipment at an airport in the southern Yemeni city of al-Mukalla, which it said had been transported by Saudi Arabia for use by pro-government forces. Meanwhile, Houthi-run media reported that at least six people had been killed and 11 injured in air and artillery strikes over the previous 24 hours.

articles.title: Austrian and Swiss women held captive for more than a year in Niger freed in Libya
articles.summary: The Swiss government told the BBC that the freed national was on her way back to Switzerland.
articles.body_text: Two women - a Swiss and an Austrian – have been freed after more than a year in captivity in Niger and handed over to authorities in the Libyan city of Benghazi. Austrian national Eva Gretzmacher, 76, and Swiss Claudia Abbt, 69, were kidnapped separately in the northern Nigerien city of Agadez in January and April last year. No details have been given about who was holding them or their demands, although some reports have previously linked the kidnapping to Islamic State militants. The circumstances of their release were not disclosed. The Austrian and Swiss governments have both confirmed the release of their citizens. The Swiss government said Abbt was free and on her way back to Switzerland, while Austria said Gretzmacher had been released after "intensive diplomatic efforts". "We are all very relieved that Eva G. is free again after more than 21 months... For many months, we worked closely, discreetly, and in a spirit of trust with our regional, European, and international partners. These joint efforts have paid off," Foreign Minister Beate Meinl-Reisinger said in a statement. The Swiss foreign ministry said the country's federal administration officials had met Abbt in Benghazi and she had received medical care. "She is doing well under the circumstances and is currently on her way back to Switzerland," it added. Federal Councillor Ignazio Cassis thanked those involved in her release, adding that he was "relieved that [she] is free again after more than a year and a half". The government said it had established a task force - including the foreign affairs department, police and other agencies - after the kidnapping became known. It added that Switzerland had maintained regular contact with Austria from the outset. Earlier, Libyan officials were reported as saying the women would be handed over to authorities in their respective countries after necessary procedures were completed.

articles.title: South Korea: Celebrity shark guided out of Busan canal refuses to swim out to sea
articles.summary: Bukangi the shark became an unlikely sensation after it was spotted in a canal in Busan weeks ago.
articles.body_text: A famed dusky shark in South Korea is still lingering near a canal that it was guided out of on Wednesday. The shark, nicknamed Bukangi, became an unlikely sensation after it was spotted swimming in a canal in the south-eastern port city of Busan last month. For weeks, rescuers tried in vain to get it back to the open sea using large nets. On Thursday, authorities said they had reinforced barriers to prevent Bukangi from returning. But it has yet to swim out into the open sea, and has been circling back repeatedly to the mouth of the waterway. Its rescue prompted mixed reactions in Busan, where some said the shark should stay while others felt it was better for it to go. In a livestreamed operation on Wednesday, rescue workers took more than eight hours to delicately guide the three-metre-long (10ft) shark with a net towards open water in a harbour. Hundreds of adoring fans gathered at the park overlooking the canal, cheering and waving goodbye to the shark. But then, on Thursday morning, Bukangi reportedly swam back into the canal after breaking through a barrier installed by authorities. For some time, Bukangi was trapped in a tight space between two layers of nets in the canal. Rescuers freed it by removing the outer layer, and have since fortified the remaining layer of nets to prevent it from going back in. Since then, authorities said, Bukangi has been swimming further out but keeps circling back. A government official told the BBC on Thursday afternoon that rescuers had concluded their operations to free the shark. It is thought that Bukangi might have been drawn to the canal by unusually warm waters and plenty of fish. With the sea getting warmer each year, experts say Busan may play host to more sharks in the future.

articles.title: Why is a peat fire so bad? BBC is in Indonesia to find out
articles.summary: The BBC's Liza Tambunan is in central Kalimantan, to explain what peat is and why Indonesia is facing its worst wildfire season in a decade.
articles.body_text: The BBC's Liza Tambunan is in central Kalimantan, as Indonesia is facing its worst wildfire season in a decade. A toxic haze has been choking millions of residents in the region, and has spread to neighbouring countries such as Singapore and Malaysia. So why has it been so bad? Liza Tambunan explains what peat is, and why peatland fires are so difficult to contain. It is thought the shark may have been drawn to the canal by unusually warm water and plenty of fish. At least 33 pupils and a teacher were killed according to hospital officials, and more than a dozen were injured. Châtaigniers en fleurs, also known as Chestnut Trees in Blossom, is expected to receive record bids at auction this weekend. A flash flood at the Budhi Gandaki River has swept away several buildings and bridges, two months after catastrophic floods hit the country. Tens of thousands of security personnel have been deployed and roads barricaded in Delhi to stop the latest Cockroach Janta Party demonstration. Thailand’s Queen Suthida made her first solo flight in a fighter jet, according to the Thai Royal Household. The municipality building in Baglung was left teetering on an unstable ledge due to floods before it fell into a river. As sellers waded through floodwaters to sell produce like fish and vegetables from floating platforms and foam boxes, buyers walked or paddled between the makeshift stalls to buy their groceries. BBC correspondent Azadeh Moshiri reports from Delhi, where hundreds of women are protesting.

articles.title: Meta fined $25bn for 'lies' over user data privacy
articles.summary: The fine is the largest to date against Facebook's owner, larger than an $18bn deal with California.
articles.body_text: Meta, the company behind Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp has been hit with its largest fine ever for its business practices. A judge in New Mexico on Wednesday ordered the company to pay $25bn (£18.6bn) following a two-week trial earlier this year that found it had spent years lying to the public about how it handled Facebook user data. "The lies extend beyond Facebook's data practices as well," the judge said, adding they went to "the heart of Facebook's core business practices". Meta's head lawyer CJ Mahoney said the ruling made it "all but impossible to do business in the state of New Mexico". The company intends to appeal, a move Mahoney said will be successful. The fine is the largest to date against Meta, which has either been fined or agreed to settle several other lawsuits this year, including an $18bn deal with California over child safety. New Mexico's lawsuit stemmed from the role of Meta, then still doing business as Facebook, in what became known as the Cambridge Analytica scandal. That firm utilised data and information from millions of Facebook users as part of its work in political consulting, including on work related to the 2016 US Presidential election, which saw Donald Trump elected for the first time. New Mexico had also accused Meta of intentionally misleading the public on how it benefitted from content that included hate speech, and how such rules against it were enforced. The jury found the company had intentionally misled the public on those claims, too. Meta disputed those accusations. "At its core, this lawsuit seeks to impose a tax on speech to enforce new rules for what people can say online," Mahoney added. Lawyers for New Mexico sued the company over many statements Meta executives had made over the years that user data was never shared with or accessed by third parties without a user's permission, when in reality it had been. They claimed that the entire population of the state, roughly two million people, was impacted by Meta's dishonesty regarding the way it controlled user data. A jury found that Meta had violated state laws more than 40 million times. "For too long, powerful technology companies have operated as though their size and influence put them beyond the reach of the law," New Mexico Attorney General Raúl Torrez said on Wednesday.

articles.title: Missiles hit Kyiv after Russia agrees to resume Ukraine peace talks
articles.summary: Moscow says it is "ready in principle" to resume peace talks and US President Donald Trump says the world is "the closest we've been" to ending the war.
articles.body_text: Ukraine's capital has come under a new missile attack, hours after Russia said it was "ready in principle" to resume peace talks and the US president said the world was "the closest we've been" to ending the war. Several houses were hit on Wednesday night, injuring six people, Kyiv Mayor Vitaliy Klitschko said. The attack came amid a new diplomatic push led by Donald Trump's envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner. Witkoff met Russia's President Vladimir Putin in the city of St Petersburg on Wednesday - a day after meeting Ukraine's leader. Three-way talks were paused in February, after which Russia stepped up attacks as Ukraine ran out of Western-supplied interceptors to defend against missiles. Speaking on Wednesday, Trump said: "The other day I was talking to Vladimir Putin about settling his war with Ukraine, which I think we're getting closer to, by the way, maybe now the closest we've been." The US president has so far failed to bring the Russia-Ukraine war to an end despite his repeated comments that he would be able to achieve this. Trump's special envoy Witkoff went to St Petersburg after meeting Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky as well as the leaders of Norway and Finland in the Norwegian capital, Oslo, on Tuesday. It is not clear what specific proposals Witkoff brought to Putin, but Zelensky said after the talks that "strong" security guarantees for Ukraine and energy ceasefire proposals had been discussed. Putin's aide Yuri Ushakov said their ideas were not very "useful". Top officials from Russia, Ukraine and the US have held several rounds of talks aimed at ending the war. Russia blamed last month's "massive" Ukrainian strikes during its general elections for their disruption. Putin launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, and Moscow currently controls about 20% of Ukrainian territory.

articles.title: Macron accuses foreign leaders of exploiting French riots for political gain
articles.summary: The comment is an apparent swipe at Benjamin Netanyahu and Donald Trump, who both face elections in coming weeks.
articles.body_text: French President Emmanuel Macron has accused foreign leaders of exploiting the riots which erupted across the country on Saturday for electoral purposes. Without naming them, he said they were campaigning for forthcoming elections "at France's expense" with their comments on the violence, which erupted on the fringe of cost-of-living protests. Speaking on a visit to the Middle East, he referred to them as "leaders who are in campaign mode, whether here in the region or on the other side of the Atlantic". It was an apparent swipe at Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, who faces parliamentary elections next week, and US President Donald Trump, for whom mid-term polls fall next month. Macron said the unnamed leaders had been influenced by fake videos generated by AI about the riots. Nearly 150 people have been jailed and more than 800 brought before the courts since the riots which gripped Paris and other cities including Lyon, Marseille and Nice. Video of running battles between masked rioters and police, as well as property being destroyed and stores being looted, spread across social media. The government admitted the police had "lost control" during the violence, which came after weeks of protests by students over conditions in high schools. Macron vowed afterwards that the authorities would be "uncompromising" towards "agitators from ultra-left fringe groups", which he blamed for much of the trouble. Speaking in the Qatari capital Doha, the French president said: "For me, there is no visible foreign interference in the events that took place. On the other hand, there was foreign manipulation of information afterwards, yes, and that gave rise to unacceptable and stupid comments from many people, including foreign leaders... "We had people claiming that we had been invaded by hordes of migrants and Islamists, which is completely false." On Tuesday, Netanyahu said in an interview for Israel's i24 channel that France, which has Western Europe's largest Muslim minority, had been hit by an "invasion of extremist Islam".

articles.title: Christa Pike, la condenada a muerte que sobrevivió dos veces la inyección letal, ya camina
articles.summary: Christa Pike, condenada a muerte por el asesinato de una compañera en 1995, muestra avances tras sobrevivir a dos inyecciones letales el 30 de septiembre. Su abogado informó que ya puede caminar por su cuenta y hablar con mayor claridad
articles.body_text: Christa Pike, la condenada a muerte en Tennesee (Estados Unidos) que sobrevivió a dos inyecciones letales, ya puede caminar por su cuenta y ha mejorado su capacidad para hablar, informó TMZ. El pasado 30 de septiembre Pike sobrevivió a dos inyecciones letales de pentobarbital, lo que obligó a suspender su ejecución e ingresarla en un hospital donde estuvo varios días inconsciente. Ahora “está logrando avances significativos en su recuperación”, aunque los médicos aún intentan determinar el alcance real de cualquier daño psicológico o cognitivo permanente que haya podido sufrir, explica el medio estadounidense. Un abogado de Pike informó a TMZ que la condenada continúa mejorando físicamente y ahora es capaz de caminar más por su cuenta, mientras puede hablar mejor, lo que le permite comunicarse con mayor claridad y formar oraciones completas. No obstante, su abogado indicó que su funcionamiento cognitivo y psicológico sigue bajo observación, y que podría pasar un mes o más antes de tener un diagnóstico claro sobre los posibles efectos a largo plazo de lo ocurrido. Esta última actualización representa una mejora importante para Pike, quien inicialmente quedó inconsciente e incapaz de comunicarse tras su ejecución fallida. Su recuperación se produce, además y según TMZ, tras conocerse algunos detalles sobre la respuesta de emergencias tras su intento de ejecución. Según las grabaciones de las llamadas al 911, las autoridades penitenciarias tardaron 31 minutos en confirmar que la solicitud de asistencia médica era legítima, debido a una confusión entre el personal de la prisión y los equipos de respuesta a emergencias que retrasó la intervención. Christa Pike fue condenada a muerte por el brutal asesinato, ocurrido en 1995, de su compañera de clase, Colleen Slemmer. El gobernador de Tennessee, Bill Lee, ha suspendido las ejecuciones a la espera de una revisión independiente del procedimiento fallido.

articles.title: Precio del dólar en República Dominicana hoy, jueves 22 de octubre: cuánto cuesta el USD a DOP, compra y venta
articles.summary: Consulta el precio del dólar en República Dominicana hoy, 22 de octubre, la compra y venta del BCRD y cómo convertir dólares a pesos dominicanos.
articles.body_text: El precio del dólar en República Dominicana para consultar este jueves 22 de octubre de 2026 tiene como última referencia verificable en la portada del Banco Central de la República Dominicana (BCRD) una tasa de RD$60.9812 para la compra y RD$61.3699 para la venta por cada dólar estadounidense. Estos valores corresponden al miércoles 21 de octubre, no a una actualización oficial del día 22. Redondeada a dos decimales, la cotización equivale a RD$60.98 para la compra y RD$61.37 para la venta. La referencia permite orientar una conversión entre dólares estadounidenses (USD) y pesos dominicanos (DOP), pero no debe confundirse con el precio que ofrece cada banco en sus canales de atención.bancentral. Para quienes necesitan consultar el cambio durante la mañana de este jueves, resulta fundamental distinguir la fecha de consulta de la fecha del dato. Las palabras compra y venta se interpretan desde la perspectiva de la entidad que cambia las divisas, no desde la del cliente. Esta diferencia ayuda a identificar qué cotización corresponde utilizar antes de calcular una operación. Por ejemplo, quien recibe dinero en dólares y quiere convertirlo a moneda local debe fijarse en la compra. En cambio, quien dispone de pesos y necesita dólares debe consultar la venta. Elegir la columna equivocada genera una estimación distinta del importe que finalmente recibirá o pagará. Las cotizaciones de ventanilla tienen otra metodología: recogen los precios anunciados al público al inicio del día y se publican antes de las 12:30 p. m. articles.title: Comisión Bicameral aprueba crédito suplementario de S/ 8.228 millones con prioridad en medidas para enfrentar el fenómeno de El Niño
articles.summary: El dictamen, aprobado con 32 votos a favor y ninguno en contra, autoriza recursos adicionales equivalentes al 3,19% del presupuesto disponible para 2026.
articles.body_text: La Comisión Bicameral de Presupuesto y de la Cuenta General de la República aprobó el dictamen que autoriza un crédito suplementario de S/ 8.228 millones para el presupuesto público de 2026, con prioridad en las acciones de prevención y mitigación frente al fenómeno de El Niño 2026-2027. La propuesta, correspondiente a la Proposición de Ley 000005-2026-2031-CR, recibió 32 votos a favor, ninguno en contra y dos abstenciones. El presidente de la comisión, José Arista Arbildo, de Fuerza Popular, sustentó el dictamen, que contó con el respaldo del ministro de Economía y Finanzas, Elmer Cuba Bustinza. Según Arista, los recursos adicionales representan un incremento de 3,19% respecto del presupuesto disponible. La iniciativa también contempla fondos para atender obligaciones pendientes y reforzar áreas como infraestructura, seguridad ciudadana, salud y educación. El documento busca que las entidades competentes cuenten oportunamente con recursos para ejecutar intervenciones antes de que se materialicen o intensifiquen los riesgos asociados al fenómeno de El Niño. MEF defiende el costo del endeudamiento Uno de los puntos de discusión fue el financiamiento del crédito suplementario mediante la emisión de bonos. Durante el debate, la diputada Katherine Ampuero, de Renovación Popular, cuestionó que casi la mitad de los recursos provenga de este mecanismo y pidió conocer cuánto deberá pagar el Estado por los intereses. La legisladora también observó una asignación de S/ 15 millones para el pago de una bonificación extraordinaria al personal administrativo del Ministerio de Economía y Finanzas. En respuesta a las preocupaciones sobre el costo de la deuda, el ministro Elmer Cuba señaló que los bonos del Tesoro peruano pagan una tasa promedio anual de 6,3%, nivel que consideró bajo en comparación con el de otros países de la región. “Muchos países vecinos, salvo el caso de Chile y de Uruguay, pagan tasas de interés superiores a 8%, 9% o 10%”, sostuvo. Cuba defendió así la capacidad del país para acceder a financiamiento en condiciones que calificó como razonables. No obstante, durante la sesión, Ampuero solicitó información específica sobre los intereses que generaría la emisión de bonos vinculada al crédito. ¿Qué otros gastos contempla el crédito suplementario? Arista indicó que S/ 1.596,7 millones se destinarán a atender obligaciones que calificó como ineludibles, entre ellas las pensiones de la Caja de Pensiones Militar Policial y los compromisos relacionados con el Fondo de Estabilización de Precios de los Combustibles. Durante la discusión también se abordó la continuidad de proyectos de inversión y reconstrucción. El diputado Henry Albañil, del Partido Cívico Obras, planteó incorporar una disposición complementaria para facilitar el financiamiento de intervenciones a cargo de gobiernos regionales y locales que requieren recursos para culminar, liquidar o atender proyectos en ejecución. Cuba explicó que el crédito recoge principalmente solicitudes presentadas por los propios sectores y que las necesidades adicionales de nuevos proyectos podrían evaluarse en el presupuesto público de 2027. “Nos importa mucho mantener la continuidad de los proyectos y la calidad de los servicios”, afirmó el ministro, quien precisó que el crédito suplementario representa alrededor del 3% del presupuesto y no sustituye la distribución de recursos prevista para el siguiente año. Compra de aviones e incendios forestales Otro de los temas discutidos fue la adquisición de aviones para la defensa nacional. El diputado César Revilla, de Fuerza Popular, defendió la compra y sostuvo que también contribuiría a combatir el narcotráfico. Cuba respaldó la adquisición desde el enfoque de seguridad nacional y señaló que las aeronaves tienen una función disuasiva. El ministro también informó que el Ejecutivo estaba procesando un posible decreto supremo solicitado por el Ministerio de Defensa para destinar S/ 21 millones a la compra de helibaldes, equipos utilizados para combatir incendios forestales. La aprobación del dictamen constituye un paso dentro del trámite legislativo de la propuesta. Los recursos previstos buscan atender necesidades inmediatas y reforzar la capacidad de respuesta del Estado, especialmente ante los riesgos climáticos, aunque el debate también dejó planteadas preguntas sobre el costo del financiamiento y las prioridades de gasto.

articles.body_text: El precio del dólar cerró este miércoles 21 de octubre en S/3,435, por encima de los S/3,427 de la jornada anterior, lo que representó una depreciación del sol peruano de 0,23%. La cotización avanzó en el mercado local pese al ligero retroceso de la moneda estadounidense a nivel internacional, en una sesión marcada por el comportamiento mixto de las divisas y las materias primas. “El Índice del Dólar Estadounidense (DXY) retrocedió 0,06%, hasta los 101.673 puntos, mientras los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro estadounidense a 10 y 30 años descendieron a 5,109% y 5,411%, respectivamente. El mercado continúa evaluando los riesgos inflacionarios asociados al conflicto entre Estados Unidos e Irán y sus implicancias para las próximas decisiones de la Reserva Federal”, explicó Jorge Luis Huayta, trader FX de Kambista. En los mercados internacionales, el petróleo WTI retrocedió 0,63%, hasta US$97,20 por barril, mientras el oro avanzó 0,37% y el cobre 0,34%. En contraste, la plata cayó 0,36%. Por su parte, el euro perdió 0,01% y la libra esterlina ganó 0,14%, mientras en América Latina el real brasileño retrocedió 0,15% y el peso mexicano 1,26%. En el mercado local, el tipo de cambio fluctuó entre S/3,430 y S/3,436, con un volumen negociado de US$373.8 millones. La jornada mostró una tendencia predominantemente alcista, influida por los flujos propios del mercado cambiario peruano, pese a la caída del dólar global y de los rendimientos de los bonos estadounidenses. De acuerdo con Huayta, el escenario internacional continúa condicionado por las tensiones en Medio Oriente, la evolución de los precios de las materias primas y las expectativas sobre la política monetaria de la Reserva Federal. En el ámbito local, el Fenómeno El Niño sigue siendo un factor de riesgo por sus posibles efectos sobre los principales sectores productivos del país. Por su parte, Allisson Pérez, trader de Divisas en Renta4 SAB, agregó que el debilitamiento global del dólar, en medio de la caída de los precios del petróleo y el ajuste de posiciones en los mercados, podría generar presiones bajistas sobre el USD/PEN. No obstante, la evolución del sol dependerá también de los flujos locales de oferta y demanda de divisas y de las expectativas sobre la política monetaria de EE.UU.

articles.title: Papa León XIV sigue su recuperación en El Vaticano y presidirá el miércoles la audiencia general
articles.summary: Papa León XIV sigue su recuperación en El Vaticano y presidirá el miércoles la audiencia general
articles.body_text: León XIV, operado la pasada semana de un tumor canceroso en el pulmón, sigue su recuperación en el Palacio Apostólico vaticano y el próximo miércoles volverá a celebrar la habitual Audiencia General en la Plaza de San Pedro, informaron fuentes de la oficina de prensa de la Santa Sede. El pontífice permanecerá en El Vaticano, según las citadas fuentes, y no se desplazará esta semana a la localidad de Castelgandolfo -a unos 30 kilómetros de Roma- como solía hacer antes de su operación para descansar la tarde del lunes y el martes. El papa estadounidense-peruano, de 71 años, fue intervenido el pasado 13 de octubre en el hospital Gemelli de Roma por un adenocarcinoma (un tipo de cáncer) en una cirugía en la que le extirparon el lóbulo inferior del pulmón derecho. El sábado recibió el alta hospitalaria tras una favorable recuperación y regresó al Vaticano, donde el domingo volvió a presidir el rezo del ángelus.El propio León XIV explicó públicamente tras la plegaria que, una vez superada la “delicada” etapa de la operación, retomará gradualmente sus actividades. Además de la audiencia general del miércoles, para esta semana se prevé que León XIV reciba el jueves o viernes a los participantes del Congreso Internacional sobre la Pastoral Escolar y Universitaria que, con el lema “Trazando nuevos caminos de esperanza”, se celebrará los días 22 y 23 de octubre en el Aula Pablo VI del Vaticano.

articles.title: Christa Pike, la condenada a muerte que sobrevivió dos veces la inyección letal, ya camina
articles.summary: Christa Pike, condenada a muerte por el asesinato de una compañera en 1995, muestra avances tras sobrevivir a dos inyecciones letales el 30 de septiembre. Su abogado informó que ya puede caminar por su cuenta y hablar con mayor claridad
articles.body_text: Christa Pike, la condenada a muerte en Tennesee (Estados Unidos) que sobrevivió a dos inyecciones letales, ya puede caminar por su cuenta y ha mejorado su capacidad para hablar, informó TMZ. El pasado 30 de septiembre Pike sobrevivió a dos inyecciones letales de pentobarbital, lo que obligó a suspender su ejecución e ingresarla en un hospital donde estuvo varios días inconsciente. Ahora “está logrando avances significativos en su recuperación”, aunque los médicos aún intentan determinar el alcance real de cualquier daño psicológico o cognitivo permanente que haya podido sufrir, explica el medio estadounidense. Un abogado de Pike informó a TMZ que la condenada continúa mejorando físicamente y ahora es capaz de caminar más por su cuenta, mientras puede hablar mejor, lo que le permite comunicarse con mayor claridad y formar oraciones completas. No obstante, su abogado indicó que su funcionamiento cognitivo y psicológico sigue bajo observación, y que podría pasar un mes o más antes de tener un diagnóstico claro sobre los posibles efectos a largo plazo de lo ocurrido. Esta última actualización representa una mejora importante para Pike, quien inicialmente quedó inconsciente e incapaz de comunicarse tras su ejecución fallida. Su recuperación se produce, además y según TMZ, tras conocerse algunos detalles sobre la respuesta de emergencias tras su intento de ejecución. Según las grabaciones de las llamadas al 911, las autoridades penitenciarias tardaron 31 minutos en confirmar que la solicitud de asistencia médica era legítima, debido a una confusión entre el personal de la prisión y los equipos de respuesta a emergencias que retrasó la intervención. Christa Pike fue condenada a muerte por el brutal asesinato, ocurrido en 1995, de su compañera de clase, Colleen Slemmer. El gobernador de Tennessee, Bill Lee, ha suspendido las ejecuciones a la espera de una revisión independiente del procedimiento fallido.

articles.title: Un pueblo japonés que envejece busca nuevos residentes en el Perú
articles.summary: Con el 70% de sus habitantes mayores de 65 años y apenas dos o tres nacimientos al año, la localidad japonesa de Nanmoku firmó un acuerdo con Belén, en Iquitos, para atraer a jóvenes peruanos que quieran establecerse allí y ayudar a frenar su despoblación.
articles.body_text: Aquejada por el envejecimiento, la localidad japonesa de Nanmoku tomó una iniciativa drástica: invitar a visitantes de una zona amazónica del Perú para convencerlos de venir y hacer revivir una comunidad en riesgo de extinción. La alcaldesa de la localidad peruana de Belén y dos mujeres jóvenes visitaron recientemente un hogar de ancianos en Nanmoku, aldea de 1.300 habitantes en la prefectura de Gunma, donde saludaron a los residentes, algunos de los cuales se mostraron sorprendidos. “Nanmoku es una ciudad muy bonita. Desde que llegué empecé a admirar todo”, declaró a la AFP Wendy Sangama, estudiante de 19 años que pasó una semana en Japón, tras la firma de un acuerdo de ciudades hermanas entre Belén y Nanmoku. “Si tengo la oportunidad de venir a vivir aquí, lo haría”, aseguró. Se trata del municipio más envejecido de Japón, con 70% de sus habitantes de 65 años o más. Un informe de un centro de estudios lo calificó en 2014 como “el que está más en riesgo de desaparecer”. La principal calle a orillas del río Nanmoku está bordeada de casas y comercios, algunos desocupados, y parecía abandonada el fin de semana lluvioso cuando llegó la AFP. Las autoridades esperan que el acuerdo, que promueve vínculos culturales e interpersonales entre ambas ciudades, atraiga jóvenes de Belén para que vivan en Nanmoku, aunque no está claro cómo podrían obtener la residencia. Perú tiene la tercera mayor población de nikkei, es decir inmigrantes japoneses y sus descendientes. El alcalde de Nanmoku, Saijo Hasegawa, comentó que su pueblo necesita “ampliar sus horizontes y atraer más residentes, incluso extranjeros”. “Sin ellos, podríamos alcanzar un punto en el que incluso el transporte público deje de operar”, admitió. Pese al rápido envejecimiento de su población y la escasez de mano de obra, en Japón crece la oposición a la inmigración, lo que llevó a la primera ministra, Sanae Takaichi, a adoptar mayores restricciones a los extranjeros. Nanmoku probó varias iniciativas para atraer a jóvenes de otras partes del país, pero las opciones de empleo son escasas. “Unas 60 personas mueren aquí cada año, y solo nacen dos o tres bebés”, precisó Hasegawa. Por el contrario, Belén es joven. El empobrecido distrito de la ciudad de Iquitos, remota ciudad amazónica en el noreste de Perú, tiene una edad promedio de 27 años. Con unos 60.000 residentes, la llamada Venecia Amazónica -accesible solo por avión o bote- está llena de casas de madera construidas sobre pilotis para enfrentar las crecidas del río Itaya, afluente del Amazonas. “Creo que los jóvenes estarían más entusiasmados de vivir en otras ciudades debido a la situación que tenemos”, comentó a la AFP la alcaldesa Lina Arista López. Los residentes del distrito dependen en gran parte del comercio informal y la agricultura, con cultivos como yuca, arroz y maíz. “Tenemos una situación difícil en Belén. No hay empleo”, agregó la alcaldesa peruana. Ketsi Yahuarcani, estudiante de 23 años, consideró “increíble” la visita a Nanmoku por la calidez que sintió entre los habitantes. “Si se diera la oportunidad de radicarme aquí lo haría”, expresó. Sangama, la otra estudiante, comentó que trasladarse allí sería “una mejor opción” para construir un futuro más próspero y ayudar a su familia en Perú. Pero admitió que sería difícil no ver a los suyos con regularidad. Municipios vecinos de Nanmoku recibieron trabajadores extranjeros, sobre todo cuidadores de ancianos, pero generalmente con programas de corto plazo en áreas laborales específicas. Hasegawa afirma tener una idea diferente. En lugar de atraer gente para vivir unos años, espera recibir pobladores de Belén como residentes a largo plazo. “El enfoque de traer trabajadores de una agencia solo porque nos falta personal no es lo que necesita nuestra aldea”, comentó. Yuki Wanibuchi, de 34 años, quien se mudó a Nanmoku hace varios años desde Kioto, consideró que los extranjeros enfrentarían dificultades, incluida la barrera idiomática. “No puedes vivir aquí sin un automóvil, y obtener la licencia de conducir requiere habilidades japonesas”, señaló. Hiroshi Ihara, un vecino de 87 años, declaró a la AFP ver a la comunidad envejecer cada vez más, mientras jóvenes como sus tres hijos se mudan a ciudades grandes para ganarse la vida. “Quiero que venga más gente joven a vivir en la aldea”, comentó. “La población japonesa se está encogiendo. Sería mejor si pudiera venir gente del exterior a hacer lo posible para apoyarnos”, subrayó.

articles.title: Últimos feriados 2026 en el Perú: ¿Cuántos feriados hay en noviembre y diciembre?

articles.body_text: Con el final de ciertas celebraciones del año, muchos trabajadores y estudiantes ya empiezan a revisar el calendario para conocer cuál será el siguiente descanso oficial del año. Los feriados representan una oportunidad para planificar viajes, compartir tiempo en familia o simplemente hacer una pausa en la rutina, por lo que existe un gran interés en conocer las próximas fechas establecidas por ley. Además de permitir un espacio para el descanso, estas jornadas suelen generar un importante movimiento en sectores como el turismo, el comercio, la gastronomía y el transporte, debido al incremento de personas que aprovechan los días libres para salir de la ciudad o realizar diversas actividades. Del mismo modo, muchas empresas y entidades organizan con anticipación sus operaciones para adecuarse al calendario oficial, mientras que las familias aprovechan estas fechas para programar reuniones, escapadas de fin de semana o visitas a distintos destinos del país. Por ello, conocer con anticipación cuándo será el próximo feriado resulta clave para organizar la agenda personal y laboral, evitar contratiempos y sacar el máximo provecho a los días de descanso que aún quedan en el 2026. A continuación, te contaremos todo lo que debes saber sobre esta situación. articles.summary: Un incendio afecta los totorales del lago Titicaca, en Puno, cerca de Los Uros. La Marina trabaja para evitar que las llamas se propaguen.
articles.body_text: Un incendio de grandes proporciones afecta los totorales de la Reserva Nacional del Titicaca, en la región Puno, cerca de las islas de Los Uros. Las llamas avanzan en el sector Uros Chulluni y amenazan las viviendas de la comunidad, según un reporte de Canal N. Ante la emergencia, personal de la Marina de Guerra del Perú y de la Dirección General de Capitanías y Guardacostas (DICAPI) se movilizó hacia la zona para apoyar las labores de control del fuego. Durante su reporte desde la zona, Canal N mostró imágenes de la magnitud del incendio y advirtió sobre la proximidad de las llamas a las casas de los pobladores. El fuego se extiende a lo largo de los totorales cercanos a las islas de Los Uros, en un área donde las viviendas se encuentran próximas a la vegetación afectada. “Las viviendas están en peligro”, alertó el medio durante la transmisión, al mostrar las llamas que avanzaban por el sector. Según el reporte, el incendio abarcaba cientos de metros y posiblemente una distancia mayor, aunque no se precisó la extensión exacta del área afectada. La cercanía del fuego a las casas incrementó la preocupación por el riesgo de que las llamas alcancen a la comunidad. El presidente de la comunidad de Los Uros fue quien comunicó a las autoridades sobre el siniestro. Tras recibir la alerta, personal de la Marina de Guerra acudió al lugar para realizar labores destinadas a contener el incendio y evitar que se propague hacia otras áreas. La emergencia también movilizó a efectivos de DICAPI, que llegaron para atender el incidente. Durante su cobertura, Canal N informó que las patrulleras de la Marina de Guerra se dirigían hacia el sector para ayudar a los pobladores. Por su parte, el Ministerio de Defensa comunicó, a través de sus redes sociales, que la patrullera lacustre LP Ramis también se desplazó hacia los totorales para apoyar las acciones de control. Los trabajos para extinguir las llamas tomarían algunas horas más. Hasta el momento, se desconocen las causas que originaron el fuego y no se ha precisado la superficie total afectada. Las autoridades concentran sus esfuerzos en evitar que las llamas continúen extendiéndose y alcancen las viviendas cercanas. El incendio representa una amenaza para los totorales de la Reserva Nacional del Titicaca y para el entorno natural del que dependen las comunidades locales. De acuerdo con la información proporcionada por las autoridades, el siniestro no dejó personas heridas ni fallecidas. Sin embargo, la proximidad del fuego a las viviendas mantiene la preocupación en el sector Uros Chulluni. La emergencia ocurre en medio de otros reportes de incendios en la región Puno, mientras continúan las labores para controlar las llamas y reducir el riesgo para los pobladores.

articles.summary: Las lluvias registradas el 19 y 20 de octubre dejaron calles inundadas en Piura y dificultaron el tránsito en varios sectores de la región.
articles.body_text: Las intensas lluvias registradas el lunes 19 y el martes 20 de octubre dejaron calles anegadas en distintos sectores de Piura y complicaron el tránsito vehicular y peatonal. Las precipitaciones también se reportaron en localidades como Chulucanas y Tambogrande, en medio de las condiciones atmosféricas y oceánicas asociadas al fenómeno el niño. El Servicio Nacional de Meteorología e Hidrología del Perú (Senamhi) informó que las lluvias estuvieron relacionadas con un núcleo convectivo ubicado en la zona media alta de Piura. Asimismo, su radar identificó precipitaciones de ligera a moderada intensidad en diversas zonas de la costa. En distritos como Castilla, el agua acumulada en las calles generó preocupación entre los vecinos y dificultó el desplazamiento de vehículos y peatones. El Senamhi informó que las altas temperaturas diurnas y nocturnas continuarán en la costa peruana hasta el 31 de octubre, debido a las condiciones atmosféricas y oceánicas vinculadas al Niño Costero. Durante este periodo, se prevé cielo nublado en las primeras horas de la mañana, menor cobertura nubosa hacia el mediodía y la tarde, y un posterior incremento de la nubosidad. También se esperan lluvias dispersas en sectores de la costa norte. De acuerdo con el pronóstico, las temperaturas máximas en Piura y Tumbes oscilarán entre los 32 °C y 38 °C. A las condiciones meteorológicas se suma la persistencia de temperaturas superficiales del mar superiores a los valores habituales frente al litoral de Piura. Según información de la Dirección de Hidrografía y Navegación (DHN), al 18 de octubre la temperatura superficial del mar alcanzó los 26,2 °C en Talara y los 25,9 °C en Paita. Las anomalías registradas fueron de +8,1 °C y +8,5 °C, respectivamente. Estas condiciones favorecen temperaturas del aire por encima de lo normal, tanto durante el día como en la noche. Según el reporte, mientras persistan las anomalías positivas de la temperatura del mar, se prevé que el calor continúe durante las próximas semanas.

articles.title: Tesla says it will start selling Cybercabs by end of year | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Tesla said Wednesday it will start selling its Cybercab to customers by the end of the year, even as federal regulators investigate whether the vehicle
articles.body_text: Tesla said Wednesday it will start selling its Cybercab to customers by the end of the year, even as federal regulators investigate whether the vehicle meets vehicle safety standards . The gold-hued, autonomous two-seater lacks a steering wheel and other traditional controls. During the company’s third-quarter earnings call, Lars Moravy, vice president of engineering at Tesla, said the Cybercabs produced today are all destined for the company’s own robotaxi fleet. As that fleet grows, the company will “mainly deliver fully designed autonomous vehicles to our customers,” he said, noting that it will start small. The company will scale as it learns about delivery, ownership, and fleet management of autonomous vehicles, Moravy added. Tesla first floated the idea of selling the autonomous vehicle to third parties last month around its Cybercab event in Austin and even posted a form for people interested in buying robotaxis. But it wasn’t clear if Tesla would follow through, or how. Tesla CEO Elon Musk has talked for years about building a massive fleet of low-cost robotaxis, but until recently, those plans centered on turning privately owned Tesla vehicles into self-driving taxis with a software update. That plan has yet to materialize, and Musk’s comments on the call show how his views have shifted. If both timelines hold, it would mean third-party fleet customers would be able to buy the autonomous Cybercab and potentially operate it as a robotaxi service before Tesla owners would get access to the same autonomous capability in their own cars. Musk said the Cybercab is meant to be a ride-hailing vehicle, not a car people own. “Cybercab is primarily going to be something that is offered as like transport as a service, whereas our other cars would be more, you know, the cars that you’d want to own, like the 3 and the Y and whatnot, and the Roadster, obviously,” Musk said Wednesday on the call. “But, you know, the vast majority of the Cybercab stuff will be essentially Tesla-owned and transported as a service.” There is at least one obstacle that could throw off Tesla’s Cybercab fleet plans. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration (NHTSA), the federal auto safety regulator, announced last month that it had opened an investigation into the Cybercab, just hours after the vehicles began operating on public streets in Austin. Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standards (FMVSS) require manual controls like brake pedals, as well as other features such as rearview and side mirrors. Automakers traditionally self-certify whether their vehicles comply with FMVSS rules, and Tesla did the same. Current regulations don’t accommodate vehicles without manual controls, though the Department of Transportation recently proposed removing those requirements for vehicles that are designed to be autonomously driven. In the meantime, NHTSA said it would investigate the Cybercab to “examine the process and technical data on which Tesla relied when certifying the Cybercab and related issues.” The outcome of that investigation could affect whether Tesla, or anyone else, can legally operate the Cybercab. articles.title: Blackstone's Jas Khaira says fears over AI-buildout debt are overblown | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Blackstone’s AI head on why the PE giant isn't panicked by market jitters.
articles.body_text: Private equity giant Blackstone is putting itself at the center of the AI boom, firm veteran Jas Khaira discussed last week on stage at TechCrunch Disrupt. It is writing checks via various strategies, ranging from offering massive loans to data centers to investing in frontier AI models and applications. Earlier this year, the firm launched Blackstone N1 (BXN1), a San Francisco-based central hub for its AI initiatives. The group is led by Khaira, who relocated from New York to be at the epicenter of AI. Unlike earlier tech cycles such as mobile or SaaS, which allowed companies to reach significant scale with moderate capital, the transition to AI requires staggering amounts of investment. That need for capital is precisely why Blackstone, with its $1.3 trillion in assets under management, could play such a critical role in this tech shift. Khaira emphasized that Blackstone sets itself apart from traditional venture capitalists through its focus on compute financing and its ability to offer flexible capital structures, ranging from debt to equity. And it has been investing aggressively. “We’re the largest owner of compute outside of the hyperscalers today, whether it’s investments in neo clouds, investments in data centers, and being able to use that compute strategically to support companies,” Khaira said. For instance, BXN1 played a key role in several compute-related deals, among them Crux AI, a neocloud launched in partnership with Google to commercialize its custom TPUs, to which Blackstone committed $5 billion as an investor. It also backed four-year-old Etched , a chip startup whose rapid development has caught investor attention. Neoclouds are cloud providers that rent out AI GPU infrastructure. Blackstone pioneered a financing structure that allowed it to lend massive sums to venture-backed cloud neoclouds by analyzing both committed customer contracts and using GPUs pledged as collateral. Blackstone’s first such deal came in 2023 with CoreWeave, shortly after that neocloud saw demand explode following the launch of ChatGPT. Despite having only “30 million of revenue and minimal profitability” at that time, according to Khaira, CoreWeave approached Blackstone for a $2.3 billion loan. CoreWeave was borrowing against the considerable value of its large collection of Nvidia GPUs, with Nvidia also an investor. Blackstone also grew more comfortable with the loan because CoreWeave had contracts with blue-chip customers like Microsoft. That transaction quickly became the financing model for how Blackstone and other credit institutions provided billions in follow-on debt to CoreWeave and rival neoclouds. “One of the primary things that we’re looking to is the nature of the customer. And if the customer is an investment-grade customer — let’s say it’s Microsoft or let’s say it’s Meta — the risk gets priced relative to that customer,” Khaira said.

articles.title: Meta wants to pay for its broad AI buildout with a newly created class of stock | TechCrunch
articles.summary: The social media giant is planning a new stock strategy to help power its broad investments in AI models and services.
articles.body_text: Meta is making a big push into AI, and it’s creating a new kind of stock that could help pay for it. On Wednesday, as the company reported its third-quarter earnings, Semafor reported the company might issue non-voting stock, meaning shares that don’t give their owners a vote on company decisions, to help fund its push into artificial intelligence. During Meta’s earnings call, the company confirmed that reporting. Meta’s chief financial officer, Susan Li, said the company plans to “create a new class of non-voting capital stock, which will be distributed to all existing shareholders through a stock dividend.” Li later added that the company “created this new class of shares with the purpose of creating a publicly traded non-voting stock usable for capital raising, employee compensation, acquisitions, and other general corporate purposes while preserving the voting power of existing Class A and B shareholders.” The shares will allow the company to maintain its current “founder-led structure,” she added. They will also expand its “funding tools and give us flexibility to invest behind the unprecedented momentum we’re seeing across every part of our business, driven by AI.” Meta’s earnings were strong this past quarter, beating Wall Street expectations. The company made $64 billion in revenue, a jump of 26% from a year earlier. Its costs and expenses also rose too, however, by 68% year over year. Reality Labs, the division responsible for Meta’s AR glasses, VR headsets, and VR software, continues to lose money, though less than it used to. The company said in its earnings report that it expects the division’s losses to shrink from its 2025 levels to between $18 billion and $19 billion. Meta has made a big push into AI over the past year. The company has released several AI models, including Muse Spark and Muse Glimmer earlier this year. In recent weeks, it added Muse Wonder and Muse Spark Open, an open-weight model whose underlying parameters are publicly available for outsiders to use and build on. Meta also launched a coding agent for software developers called Muse Code. At its Meta Connect event this year, the company announced a new line of cute and cuddly avatars for AI assistant, Meta Muse, in a push to make its AI services more relatable (and also meme-able ). As far as can be discerned, those AI products are doing well. “In just a month and a half, more than 10 million people in the U.S. and Canada have set up Muse personal agents,” CEO Mark Zuckerberg said during Wednesday’s earnings call. “Growth continues to be strong, and we have been number one in the App Store almost every day.” “Now that Muse has clear product-market fit, we are entering a new phase and a more operational phase that is focused on scaling it,” Zuckerberg added, claiming later that the company expects to grow the product’s appeal to eventually “serve billions of people.” The company also noted that certain storm clouds linger on the horizon in the form of ongoing regulatory and legal issues. “We continue to monitor active legal and regulatory matters that could significantly impact our business and financial results,” said Li. “For example, we continue to see scrutiny on youth-related issues in several markets, and have a number of youth-related trials scheduled in the coming months in the United States.” When you purchase through links in our articles, we may earn a small commission . articles.title: Airbnb limits chores for guests, sparking backlash from hosts | TechCrunch
articles.summary: Hosts are threatening to leave the platform after Airbnb says that they can no longer require guests to strip beds or do other time-consuming cleaning chores.
articles.body_text: Airbnb is taking steps to limit the chores that hosts can require of guests prior to checkout, addressing a long-standing grievance among customers who often pay cleaning fees and are told they must do a list of tasks themselves. In a new policy update , Airbnb prohibits hosts from mandating that guests strip beds, wash and put away dishes, start laundry, or remove trash from the property. This new guideline will apply to reservations made on or after November 20. This change comes in response to years of backlash regarding overly burdensome checkout instructions and hefty fines for not disposing of trash. Many guests have voiced their frustrations on social media, questioning why they should be responsible for cleaning tasks after already paying a cleaning fee. However, some hosts aren’t pleased with the update. Within Airbnb’s community forums , some argue that basic cleaning responsibilities are essential for maintaining sanitary conditions and protecting their properties. They point out that hosts must manage the costs and practical demands of preparing their properties for the next guests. One host expressed concern that the new policy leans toward a hotel-like model, which detracts from the unique appeal of Airbnb. “Guests are given complete freedom to be lazy while the hosts bear the risk,” the host wrote. “The major distinction between commercial hotels and my private home is the personal touch. Guests can certainly be expected to wash their dishes or put them in the dishwasher and remove their dirty linens. In exchange, they enjoy a personal connection and a unique environment that a hotel simply can’t provide. Plus, every potential guest has the opportunity to read the listing beforehand and decide what they prefer. If these restrictions are removed, it could lead me to withdraw my listing and bid farewell to Airbnb after twelve years.” Airbnb has outlined some exceptions to the new policy, though. Hosts may still ask guests to conserve water during droughts or use bear-proof trash containers in areas where wildlife poses a risk. The policy change highlights the challenge Airbnb faces in balancing the expectations of guests versus hosts and is another step taken in addressing guests’ concerns. The company faced scrutiny in 2024 over price transparency from hosts tacking on cleaning fees after guests booked their listings. In 2023, the company said more than 260,000 hosts had reduced or eliminated their cleaning fees. In May 2025, Airbnb began displaying total prices — including fees but excluding taxes — by default in search results worldwide. It will be interesting to see how many hosts decide the new restrictions make Airbnb less attractive as a platform. But the move could also draw in more travelers who want the convenience of a rental without feeling as though they are both paying for housecleaning while still expected to clean the home themselves.
